crossRefs.note: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.
if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’ to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you…
He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!
For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”
It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him…
But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

translations.web: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,
translations.bsb: Say to wisdom, “You are my sister,” and call understanding your kinsman,
translations.kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
